payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 16:13–23 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states 1 Samuel 16:13–23 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit departs and troubles; the wording centers attention on “The LORD’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
